description: This file is a shell script that provides utility functions and commands for managing prplMesh processes, including starting, stopping, restarting, status checking, and log rolling. It also handles configuration parameter retrieval and setting within specific ODL files, signal handling, and process management tailored for a Linux environment.

methods.name: send_signal_to_prplmesh_process
methods.description: Sends a specified signal (default TERM) to a prplMesh process by name.

methods.name: start_prplmesh_process
methods.description: Starts a prplMesh process by name using start-stop-daemon.

methods.name: stop_prplmesh_process
methods.description: Stops a prplMesh process by name, attempting gentle termination first, then force KILL if needed.

methods.name: roll_logs_function
methods.description: Rotates log files for beerocks components by creating a lock, managing log links, and signaling processes to roll logs.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the script command-line options.

methods.name: odl_get_str_param
methods.description: Retrieves a parameter value from specified ODL files, using sed to parse parameter assignments.

methods.name: odl_set_param
methods.description: Sets a parameter value in the ODL configuration files, supporting string and bool types.

methods.name: ensure_platform_db
methods.description: Ensures the platform database file exists in temporary directory, copying it from shared directory if missing.

methods.name: certification_mode_to_num
methods.description: Converts a certification mode input into numeric form (0 or 1).

methods.name: set_management_and_certification_mode
methods.description: Configures management and certification modes in configuration files and platform database.

methods.name: start_func
methods.description: Starts various prplMesh services based on configuration mode.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point parsing command-line arguments and executing corresponding actions.
